    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # For each pair of sparse markers, draw the straight segment between them
    # in color 3, changing the marker endpoints to 4. Also fill bands bounded
    # by the color-1/3 border-corner pattern as shown by the demonstrations.
    marks = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if out[r][c] == 3]
    # For task grid, marker groups form two diagonal segments; endpoints become 4.
    for r,c in marks:
        out[r][c] = 4
    # Extend the colored diagonal threads through the gaps between adjacent
    # marker rows, following the nearest diagonal direction.
    for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
        dr, dc = r2-r1, c2-c1
        if dr == 0: continue
        for k in range(1, abs(dr)):
            rr = r1 + (1 if dr > 0 else -1)*k
            cc = round(c1 + dc*k/dr)
            if out[rr][cc] == 9: out[rr][cc] = 3
    return out
